_notes: ZONE5 v1 (laneZONE5, hand-made layout, kind external): Zone 5 = The Petrified Wood (Humbaba boss arena). World metres, offsetZ 177 (zone 4 offset 108 + gateZ 58 + 11), entry gate z 177, exit gate z 233, 30 m clearing centred z 209, boss_stand z 211. 21 rows, existing assets as stand-ins. HERO SLOTS: rows with heroSlot (stump_near, trunk_wall, dead_tree, stump_far) take their model from laneZONE5/kit/zone5_slots.json (slot model = a folder id under Assets/Env/Hero/<id>/<id>_LOD{0,1,2}.glb, library hero5): edit the slot or one row there and run apply_zone5.py --apply; the rows here are regenerated, do not hand edit. y is a placeholder 0: ZoneRowGround.cs (zone_ground.json) snaps every z5_ row to the real ground by raycast when its ring is on. No flagstone row on purpose (zone_ground.json floor earth).

lodProfiles.name: sky_ridge
lodProfiles._about: LOD0/LOD1 can never be selected (screen height cannot exceed 1 for a ridge in view at 10x), so every ridge is the 2.5-3.2k tri LOD2 and is never culled by size

lodProfiles.name: sky_ruin
lodProfiles._about: far_ruin LOD1 (2.6-3.3k tris) while a tower fills > 30 % of the screen height, else LOD2 (0.75-1.2k tris); LOD0 (20 MB glb) only if one fills the whole screen
